lessons: Generic operation eligibility can be true for an impassable destination. Independently inspect terrain and actual native path before issuing a unit movement. ACK/zero return never proves displacement.

When an old request has no observed movement, read both contexts and actual pending/queue before classifying. New distinct valid destination is a separate intent, not silent replay or queue cancellation.

Original UI keyboard handlers can provide a supported confirmation path when a low-resolution viewport clips a button. Read actual handler, preserve draft, press one key and observe actual confirmation/result.
Normal-player fixture prerequisites and repair operations are TEST_PLAYER evidence, never autonomous effect or model capability. Keep traits/speed/cost context and owner diagnostic failures.
